fato_historico: 1976: A British Airways Hawker Siddeley Trident and an Inex-Adria DC-9 collide near Zagreb, Yugoslavia, killing 176.
energia_do_dia: Today brings a gentle reminder of life's precious fragility, encouraging you to navigate the skies of your ambitions with newfound caution and awareness. It is a good time to cherish every connection, perhaps finding beauty in the stillness after a storm. Your radiant spirit may feel guided toward deeper empathy, transforming intense energy into profound, lasting grace.
frase_do_dia: Cherish every precious moment, for each heartbeat is a gift of pure light.
significado_numero: Represents the pursuit of truth and finding inner wisdom during changes.
conselho: Move through your day with intentional kindness and mindful steps in every direction.
